title: Global Multiplicity and Comparison Principles for Singular Problems driven by Mixed Local-Nonlocal Operators
summary: We study a singular elliptic problem driven by a mixed local-nonlocal operator of the form \begin{equation*} \begin{aligned} -Δ_p u + (-Δ_q)^s u &= \fracλ{u^δ} + u^r \text{ in } Ω\newline u > 0 \text{ in } Ω,\ u &= 0 \text{ in } \mathbb{R}^N \setminus Ω \end{aligned} \end{equation*} where $p > sq$, $0 0$ is a parameter. The nonlinearity exhibits a singular power-type behavior near zero and displays at most a critical growth at infinity.
